what_to_detect: A station ability resolves and puts charge counters on its permanent, as many as the tapped creature's power (a counter_change of type CHARGE on the source).
near_miss: A station ability resolves after tapping a creature of power 0 and puts no counters.
record_fields: sidecar line script_api_type Keyword, script_text Station:N

Forge builds the ability from the keyword, so the sidecar stores its acting line as a Keyword line (script API type Keyword, not PutCounter or ChangeZone), and outcome_event's api cannot single it out.

what_to_detect: A station ability is a playable candidate (can_play true) at sorcery timing with another untapped creature to tap.
near_miss: A station ability is not playable (can_play false): not at sorcery timing (timing false), or no other untapped creature to tap.
record_fields: verdict_bit has no parameter restricting the candidate to one keyword's line or zone: with fires_when true and no restriction, any playable candidate in any decision record fires, so the detector would tag nearly every decision record.

what_to_detect: A station ability resolves and puts charge counters on its permanent, the count set by a characteristic of the tapped creature that a static ability names in place of its power.
near_miss: A station ability resolves and puts the count its tapped creature's power gives, no static replacing the characteristic.
record_fields: the tapped creature's power and toughness in the snapshot
sidecar line script_api_type Keyword, script_text Station:N

Forge builds the ability from the keyword, so the sidecar stores its acting line as a Keyword line (script API type Keyword, not PutCounter or ChangeZone), and outcome_event's api cannot single it out.
